reference: docs/architecture/parity_pairs.md (provenance, TS<->Dart); issue #1190 provenance labels; decisions § 2406

general: Every reader loads this whole file, runs every case in every section below, and fails on a section it does not know.
A field documented as nullable is present with the JSON value null when absent.
out is one of official, verified_source, traced, community, or null where the section allows it.
schema.kinds: The four provenance values in display order; each reader asserts its own list equals this.
schema.content: {isOfficial, out}: a route, plan, gym routine, challenge or session plan. isOfficial is the server-derived is_official (nullable: a projection that does not carry it).
schema.listing: {organiserIsOfficial, provider, isVerified, out}: a race listing read from public_race_listings. organiserIsOfficial and isVerified nullable; provider is the race_listings.provider token (nullable).
schema.course: {hasCourse, organiserIsOfficial, courseSource, out}: the course linked to a race listing. out is null when hasCourse is false.
schema.badge: {kind, out}: whether a card shows the badge for this provenance (community shows none).

content.note: published by an owner/admin of a verified club
a projection without the computed field never claims official

listing.note: claimed by a club that is verified right now
the organiser outranks the provider it was synced from
a provider sync, nobody claimed it (or its club was revoked)
a provider token on an unverified row is not a partner sync
hand-added and verified by an operator, but no partner and no organiser vouches for it

course.note: drawn by the verified club from the race's published map
revoking the club takes the course's badge with it
linked by an operator before claims existed: nobody vouched for it
